auszuege.business: Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. operates as a real estate company in Japan. It operates through five segments: Leasing, Property Sales, Management, Facility Operations, and Other. The Leasing segment leases office buildings and retail facilities. The Property Sales segment is involved in the development and sale of condominiums and single-family homes for individual customers, as well as leasing housing and office buildings for investors. The Management segment engages in the property management and brokerage, and asset management businesses. The Facility Operations segment is involved in the operation of hotels and resorts, and sports and entertainment businesses. The Other segment engages in the new construction under consignment. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
